授業概要
春・夏学期は戦後日本の市民運動、学生運動について学ぶ。占領期の労働運動、反戦運動から、1960年の安保闘争、1968年の学生運動を検討する。特に1968年の九州大学電算センターファントム墜落事故と板付基地撤去運動、学生運動、ベ平連、反核運動などの運動を九州のレンズを通して見る。秋・冬学期に1970年からのウーマン・リブ、環境運動、LGBT＋運動、SEALDsなどを検討する。
In the Spring/Summer semester we will study the civil and student movements of postwar Japan. We start with the labor and anti-war movements during the occupation period, move on to the student movements that lead to the Anpo Treaty struggle of 1960, and then to the student movements of 1968. In particular, we will examine the crash of the United States Air Force Phantom jet into Kyushu University in 1968, and the resulting furor it created in Fukuoka, including the many protests on campus, the movement to remove the American Itazuke Air base from what is now the Fukuoka Airport, the anti-Vietnam War and the anti-nuclear movement, all viewed through the lens of Kyushu. In the Fall/Winter semester, we will examine citizen movements from the 1970s, including the women's liberation movement, environmental movement, LGBT+ movement, SEALDs, etc.
